c1-alkotmanyjog-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fundamental Law of 2011
c1-alkotmanyjog-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the Fundamental Law was adopted and how it was judged.
c1-alkotmanyjog-01.prompt: Say when the Fundamental Law was adopted and what the Venice Commission thought, naming the source.
cues: Give the date of the adoption
Name the source of the opinion and its content
c1-alkotmanyjog-01.target: 2011. április 18-án az Országgyűlés elfogadta az Alaptörvényt. A Velencei Bizottság 2011-es véleménye szerint a sarkalatos törvények köre aggályos volt.
c1-alkotmanyjog-01.english: On 18 April 2011 the National Assembly adopted the Fundamental Law. According to the Venice Commission's opinion of 2011, the range of cardinal laws was a cause for concern.
c1-alkotmanyjog-01.canDo: I can describe how the Fundamental Law was adopted in 2011, with the dates and the source of each view (*Alaptörvény, Nemzeti Hitvallás, sarkalatos törvény*).

c1-alkotmanyjog-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Constitutional Complaint after 2012
c1-alkotmanyjog-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what changed for those who wanted to turn to the Constitutional Court.
c1-alkotmanyjog-02.prompt: Say what replaced the actio popularis in 2012 and what the complainant had to do first.
cues: Say what replaced the actio popularis and from when
Say what the person concerned had to do first
c1-alkotmanyjog-02.target: 2012. január 1-jétől az alkotmányjogi panasz váltotta fel az actio popularist, és az érintett köteles volt előbb kimeríteni a rendes jogorvoslatokat.
c1-alkotmanyjog-02.english: From 1 January 2012 the constitutional complaint replaced the actio popularis, and the person concerned had to exhaust the ordinary legal remedies first.
c1-alkotmanyjog-02.canDo: I can describe the changes to the Constitutional Court's powers between 2010 and 2013, with their dates (*hatáskör, alkotmányjogi panasz, actio popularis*).

c1-alkotmanyjog-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The State of Danger in 2020
c1-alkotmanyjog-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the government and the opposition argued about the authorisation of March 2020.
c1-alkotmanyjog-03.prompt: Say what the government argued and what the opposition argued, with minél … annál.
cues: Give the government's argument about speed
Give the opposition's argument about the time limit
c1-alkotmanyjog-03.target: A kormány szerint minél gyorsabban születtek meg a szabályok, annál hatékonyabb lehetett a védekezés. Az ellenzék szerint minél tovább tartott az időbeli korlát nélküli felhatalmazás, annál nagyobb volt a jogbizonytalanság kockázata.
c1-alkotmanyjog-03.english: According to the government, the faster the rules were made, the more effective the response could be. According to the opposition, the longer the authorisation without a time limit lasted, the greater the risk of legal uncertainty was.
c1-alkotmanyjog-03.canDo: I can describe the states of danger of 2020 and 2022 and the decrees issued under them, with dates (*veszélyhelyzet, kormányrendelet, felhatalmazás*).

c1-alkotmanyjog-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Judges and the Retirement Age
c1-alkotmanyjog-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what the lowering of the judges' retirement age meant.
c1-alkotmanyjog-04.prompt: Say what changed in 2012 and give one hedged assessment of its effect.
cues: State the change with the ages
Give a cautious assessment of the effect
c1-alkotmanyjog-04.target: A bírák kötelező nyugdíjkorhatárát hetvenről hatvankét évre csökkentették, és ez valószínűleg hatással volt a bírói kar összetételére.
c1-alkotmanyjog-04.english: The mandatory retirement age of judges was lowered from seventy to sixty-two, and this probably affected the composition of the judiciary.
c1-alkotmanyjog-04.canDo: I can describe the rules on judges and public offices between 2011 and 2016, with their dates (*nyugdíjkorhatár, Országos Bírói Hivatal, Kúria*).

c1-alkotmanyjog-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Procedure of 2018
c1-alkotmanyjog-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the government and the European Parliament judged the procedure of 2018.
c1-alkotmanyjog-05.prompt: Set the government's view of the procedure against the Parliament's view.
cues: Set against it the Parliament's view
c1-alkotmanyjog-05.target: A kormány szerint az eljárás politikai indíttatású volt, ezzel szemben az Európai Parlament szerint a jogállamiság helyzete aggályos volt.
c1-alkotmanyjog-05.english: According to the government, the procedure was politically motivated; in contrast, according to the European Parliament, the state of the rule of law was a cause for concern.
c1-alkotmanyjog-05.canDo: I can describe the European rule-of-law procedures of 2018–2023 and the change of government in 2026, with dates (*jogállamiság, felfüggesztés, állásfoglalás*).

c1-alkotmanyjog-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-alkotmanyjog-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period from the adoption of the Fundamental Law to the election of 2026.
c1-alkotmanyjog-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Mention the adoption of the Fundamental Law
Mention the state of danger of 2020
c1-alkotmanyjog-consolidation.target: 2011-ben az Országgyűlés elfogadta az Alaptörvényt. 2020-ban a kormány veszélyhelyzetet hirdetett, a bírálók szerint viszont aggályos volt az időbeli korlát nélküli felhatalmazás. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt kétharmados többséget szerzett.
c1-alkotmanyjog-consolidation.english: In 2011 the National Assembly adopted the Fundamental Law. In 2020 the government declared a state of danger, but according to the critics the authorisation without a time limit was a cause for concern. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won a two-thirds majority.
c1-alkotmanyjog-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the Fundamental Law, the Constitutional Court's powers and the states of danger between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.

c1-mediaszabadsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Népszabadság in 2016
c1-mediaszabadsag-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked why Népszabadság stopped appearing in 2016.
c1-mediaszabadsag-01.prompt: Say what the publisher stated and what the critics said.
c1-mediaszabadsag-01.target: A kiadó azt közölte, hogy a lap veszteséges volt, a bírálók viszont azt mondták, hogy politikai ok állt a háttérben.
c1-mediaszabadsag-01.english: The publisher stated that the paper was making a loss, but the critics said that there was a political reason behind it.
c1-mediaszabadsag-01.canDo: I can describe the media laws of 2010, the closure of Népszabadság in 2016 and the founding of KESMA in 2018, with dates (*médiatörvény, kiadó, egyesülés*).

c1-mediaszabadsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Klubrádió in 2021
c1-mediaszabadsag-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what happened to Klubrádió in February 2021.
c1-mediaszabadsag-02.prompt: Say what happened to the radio and what it did afterwards, with annak ellenére, hogy.
cues: Say that the radio ceased on the traditional airwaves
Say that it continued on the internet
c1-mediaszabadsag-02.target: Annak ellenére, hogy a Klubrádió 2021-ben megszűnt a hagyományos rádióhullámokon, az interneten folytatta a műsorszolgáltatást.
c1-mediaszabadsag-02.english: Although Klubrádió ceased on the traditional airwaves in 2021, it continued broadcasting on the internet.
c1-mediaszabadsag-02.canDo: I can describe the public media's set-up in 2011, the events of December 2018 and the Klubrádió decision of 2020–2021, with dates (*közszolgálati média, frekvencia, székház*).

c1-mediaszabadsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: State Advertising
c1-mediaszabadsag-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what the European Parliament thought of state advertising in 2018.
c1-mediaszabadsag-03.prompt: Say what the European Parliament called a cause for concern and what the critics said about the award.
cues: Name the object of the concern with a verbal noun
Give the critics' view about the award
c1-mediaszabadsag-03.target: Az Európai Parlament 2018-as jelentése aggályosnak nevezte az állami hirdetések elosztását. A bírálók szerint az odaítélés nem volt átlátható.
c1-mediaszabadsag-03.english: The European Parliament's report of 2018 called the distribution of state advertisements a cause for concern. According to the critics, the award was not transparent.
c1-mediaszabadsag-03.canDo: I can describe what the European Parliament, the Commission and the EMFA said about state advertising, with years (*állami hirdetés, elosztás, átláthatóság*).

c1-mediaszabadsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Index in 2020
c1-mediaszabadsag-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what happened to the Index editor-in-chief and where he went.
c1-mediaszabadsag-04.prompt: Say who was dismissed in 2020 and where he worked from 2021, with a past participle.
c1-mediaszabadsag-04.target: Az elbocsátott főszerkesztő, Dull Szabolcs 2021 januárjában a Telexhez csatlakozott.
c1-mediaszabadsag-04.english: The dismissed editor-in-chief, Szabolcs Dull, joined the Telex in January 2021.
c1-mediaszabadsag-04.canDo: I can describe the events at the Index in July 2020 and the launch of the Telex, with dates (*főszerkesztő, szerkesztőség, hírportál*).

c1-mediaszabadsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Sovereignty Protection Office
c1-mediaszabadsag-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the Sovereignty Protection Office was judged.
c1-mediaszabadsag-05.prompt: Set the government's view against the critics' view, with ugyanakkor.
c1-mediaszabadsag-05.target: A kormány szerint a hivatal a külföldi befolyásolás elleni védelmet szolgálta, a bírálók szerint ugyanakkor a független sajtó ellen is felhasználható volt.
c1-mediaszabadsag-05.english: According to the government the office served protection against foreign influence; at the same time, according to the critics it could also be used against the independent press.
c1-mediaszabadsag-05.canDo: I can describe the Sovereignty Protection Office and the European procedures about it, with dates (*szuverenitás, kötelezettségszegési eljárás, főtanácsnok*).

c1-mediaszabadsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-mediaszabadsag-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the media events from 2016 to 2026.
c1-mediaszabadsag-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
c1-mediaszabadsag-consolidation.target: 2018-ban több mint négyszáz lap, rádió és televízió a KESMA-hoz került, a kormánypárti oldal szerint ez kiegyensúlyozta a médiapiacot, a bírálók szerint viszont veszélyeztette a sokszínűséget. 2020-ban megjelent a Telex. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt kétharmados többséget szerzett.
c1-mediaszabadsag-consolidation.english: In 2018 more than four hundred papers, radios and television channels went to KESMA; according to the pro-government side this balanced the media market, but according to the critics it endangered diversity. In 2020 the Telex appeared. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won a two-thirds majority.
c1-mediaszabadsag-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the media laws, the ownership changes and the Index case between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.

c1-egeszsegugy-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Doctors' Pay
c1-egeszsegugy-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the Medical Chamber saw doctors' pay.
c1-egeszsegugy-01.prompt: Say how the chamber compared Hungarian and Austrian pay, with képest.
c1-egeszsegugy-01.target: A kamara szerint az osztrák fizetésekhez képest alacsonyak voltak a magyar orvosi fizetések.
c1-egeszsegugy-01.english: According to the chamber, Hungarian doctors' pay was low compared with Austrian pay.
c1-egeszsegugy-01.canDo: I can describe the pay agreement between the government and the Medical Chamber in 2020 and the law of 2021, with dates (*hálapénz, alapbér, béremelés*).

c1-egeszsegugy-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Hospital Debts in 2013
c1-egeszsegugy-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what happened in June 2013 between the hospitals and their suppliers.
c1-egeszsegugy-02.prompt: Say what the hospitals did not do and what the suppliers did, with emiatt.
c1-egeszsegugy-02.target: A kórházak nem fizették ki a számlákat, és emiatt a beszállítók több alkalommal jelezték, hogy nem hajlandók tovább tűrni.
c1-egeszsegugy-02.english: The hospitals did not pay the invoices, and because of this the suppliers signalled several times that they were not willing to tolerate it any longer.
c1-egeszsegugy-02.canDo: I can describe the takeover of hospitals by the state in 2012 and the hospitals' debts to suppliers (*tartozás, beszállító, számla*).

c1-egeszsegugy-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Nurses in 2021
c1-egeszsegugy-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what a survey showed about nurses in 2021.
c1-egeszsegugy-03.prompt: Say what the survey showed, with során.
cues: Name the protests and their year
Say what many nurses were considering
c1-egeszsegugy-03.target: A 2021-es tüntetések során sok ápoló elmondta, hogy a külföldi munkavállalást fontolgatja.
c1-egeszsegugy-03.english: During the protests of 2021 many nurses said they were considering working abroad.
c1-egeszsegugy-03.canDo: I can describe the nurses' protest of 2021, what nurses said about working abroad and the pay rises announced for 2022–2024, with dates (*ápoló, szakdolgozó, bérkülönbség*).

c1-egeszsegugy-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Chamber Law of 2023
c1-egeszsegugy-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what was disputed about the law on the Medical Chamber.
c1-egeszsegugy-04.prompt: Say what was disputed, with an indirect question.
cues: Say that the matter was disputed
Name the two views on the law
c1-egeszsegugy-04.target: Vitatott volt, hogy a törvény az orvosokat védte-e, vagy a kamarát gyengítette.
c1-egeszsegugy-04.english: It was disputed whether the law protected the doctors or weakened the chamber.
c1-egeszsegugy-04.canDo: I can describe the law of 28 February 2023 on the Medical Chamber and the reactions to it, with dates (*kötelező tagság, önkéntes, kivételes eljárás*).

c1-egeszsegugy-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Healthy Budapest Programme
c1-egeszsegugy-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the government judged the Healthy Budapest Programme.
c1-egeszsegugy-05.prompt: Give the government's view in spite of the delay, with ellenére.
c1-egeszsegugy-05.target: A késés ellenére a kormány szerint a program a fővárosi ellátás korszerűsítését szolgálta.
c1-egeszsegugy-05.english: In spite of the delay, according to the government the programme served the modernisation of care in the capital.
c1-egeszsegugy-05.canDo: I can describe the Healthy Budapest Programme from 2017 and the delay of the South Buda hospital, with dates (*centrumkórház, korszerűsítés, megvalósítás*).

c1-egeszsegugy-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Period in Summary
c1-egeszsegugy-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up healthcare in Hungary from 2020 to 2026.
c1-egeszsegugy-consolidation.prompt: Sum up briefly, with years and sources.
c1-egeszsegugy-consolidation.target: 2020 őszén a kormány és a kamara megállapodott az orvosok béremeléséről. 2023-ban az Országgyűlés megszüntette a kötelező kamarai tagságot. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt kétharmados többséget szerzett.
c1-egeszsegugy-consolidation.english: In autumn 2020 the government and the chamber agreed on a pay rise for doctors. In 2023 the National Assembly abolished compulsory chamber membership. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won a two-thirds majority.
c1-egeszsegugy-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the pay agreement of 2020, the hospital debts and the nurses' pay between 2010 and 2026, with years and sources.
